login.title: Internal console
login.subtitle: Restricted to The Somnus staff.
login.intro: Enter your work email and we will send you a sign-in link.
login.emailHint: A single-use link. We do not use passwords.
login.linkSent: We sent a sign-in link to {{email}}. Check your inbox.
login.error: We could not send the link. Please try again.

callback.title: Completing sign-in
callback.error: This link is not valid or has expired. Request a new one.

denied.title: You do not have console access
denied.body: Your account holds no internal Somnus role. The console is for authorised staff only.
denied.noSelfService: Internal roles are never requested or self-assigned: a platform administrator grants them.

console.title: Admin console
console.noCapabilities: Your role has no capabilities assigned yet.
console.pendingNotice: The screens for the remaining capabilities arrive in Checkpoints 15.3 to 15.5.

capability.admin_users_read: Search users and view their status

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do that.
errors.conflict: The state changed since you loaded this screen. Try again.

users.title: Users
users.truncated: There are more results than fit. Narrow your search.
users.noClinical: This view shows account metadata only. Clinical data requires break-glass access with a justification.

deletions.title: Deletion requests
deletions.irreversible: Carrying out a deletion is irreversible: it erases identity and consent data. The audit trail is retained.

organizations.title: Organizations
organizations.created: Organization created. You were not added as a member.

verification.title: Professional verification queue
verification.reasonHint: Required for approvals too: it is recorded against your identity.
verification.consequence: Approving grants the professional role. From then on they can reach clinical data of anyone who explicitly grants it to them.

contentReview.title: AI content review queue
contentReview.intro: AI-reworded text that is not visible to anyone yet. Nothing is released without a recorded human decision.
contentReview.reasonHint: Required when approving too: it is recorded with your identity and cannot be changed afterwards.
contentReview.consequence: Approving makes this text eligible for rendering. Rejecting excludes it for good.
contentReview.scannerNote: Candidates carrying prohibited claims never reach this queue: they are discarded before being shown.
contentReview.provenanceTitle: What this report was grounded in
contentReview.provenanceIntro: The material behind the deterministic result this candidate paraphrases. Recorded when the report was generated and never changed afterwards.
contentReview.provenanceNoDocuments: No supporting material. The report was grounded in the clinical sources cited above and nothing else.
contentReview.provenanceNoCitations: No safety rule cited a source in this report.
contentReview.provenanceMissing: This report recorded no corpus provenance. It was generated before provenance was recorded, or the record could not be written.

stats.title: Platform statistics
stats.intro: Aggregate only. No number here is tied to a person.
stats.truncated: Partial numbers: the read hit its cap, so these are a lower bound, not a total.
stats.empty: No data yet. The event transport is not wired, so the audit store is empty.
stats.breakGlassPending: Zero until Checkpoint 15.5: the panel is wired, the feature does not exist yet.
stats.unavailableIntro: §A2.4 asks for these, but no event carries them. Shown as gaps rather than zero: a zero is a measurement.
stats.breakGlassNone: Nobody has used break-glass in this window.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Provenance, never a copy of anyone's data. Identifiers are opaque.

roles.title: Internal roles
roles.intro: Only a platform super administrator can assign internal roles.
roles.targetHint: Find them under Users and copy their id.
roles.noSelfAssign: You cannot assign a role to yourself. Privilege escalation always passes through a second person.

breakGlass.title: Break-glass access
breakGlass.intro: Recorded access to one person's clinical answers and results. Administrative access and clinical access are different things (§A2.3): this is not part of ordinary operational access.
breakGlass.warning: Every reveal is recorded immutably with your identity, the record opened, the category and your justification, and is counted on the statistics dashboard.
breakGlass.subjectHint: The opaque identifier shown on the person's record.
breakGlass.justificationHint: At least {{min}} characters. Someone else will read this to judge the access.
breakGlass.revealedAt: Revealed at {{at}}. For this session only: nothing stays unlocked.
breakGlass.empty: This person has no saved assessments.

corpus.title: Reference corpus
corpus.intro: Reference documents the platform may cite when explaining a result. They never change the level or the routing: they only enrich the explanation.
corpus.noDeleteNote: A document is added and retired, never deleted. Retiring keeps the record, which is the only thing that keeps older reports explainable.
corpus.citationHint: How this document will be cited in a report.
corpus.localeHint: Retrieval respects language: a document is only used in its own.
corpus.textHint: Split into chunks when saved. Under “citation only” there is a length cap, and text above it is refused whole rather than trimmed.
corpus.scopesIntro: Where this document may be used: a module, a safety rule, a clinical source or, exceptionally, everything.
corpus.generalScopeNote: “General” should be rare: a document with no scope is retrieved for everything.
corpus.rightsIntro: Without a rights declaration and its evidence, a document is neither published nor indexed. The service decides that, not this screen.
corpus.changelogHint: Kept in the corpus history. At least 3 characters.
corpus.evidenceHint: Stored as evidence for the declaration.

scopeKeyHint.general: No key: it applies to everything.

rightsMeaning.own_document: Written by The Somnus. No further evidence needed.
rightsMeaning.open_access: Published under an open licence. Give the licence and the link.
rightsMeaning.licensed: Covered by an institutional subscription or purchase. Give the licence and who holds it.
rightsMeaning.citation_only: The citation and a short summary only. The platform holds no full text.

rightsWarning.licensed: Careful: declaring “licensed” asserts that a real subscription or purchase covers this use. If none does, the text ends up sent to an external provider with no right to it.
rightsWarning.citation_only: Careful: “citation only” asserts there is no full text here. There is a length cap, and longer text is refused whole rather than trimmed: if you need the full article, declare the rights that permit it.

corpusSources.title: Clinical sources
corpusSources.intro: The fifteen approved clinical sources, with what the console may add beneath each one.
corpusSources.artifactNote: The citation, link, use and citing rules of each source belong to the clinical artifact (morpheo_workflows_v1.json) and appear here to be read only. No console route is able to write them.
corpusSources.noEnrichments: Nothing has been added for this source yet.
corpusSources.addEnrichment: Add a document to this source
